TCS unaffected by US PERM suspension, plans 15,000 hires

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has stated that the suspension of the US PERM (Program Electronic Review Management) system will not impact its hiring plans. The company aims to hire 15,000 new employees in the United States. TCS also noted that it has already established a substantial local workforce across 31 offices in the US.
